deterministic_trigger: Existing status explicitly says available current green matched exact ready scored or admitted identifier present
meaning: Existing admitted evidence is available under the source system's own state

deterministic_trigger: Existing status explicitly contains stale or last-cache language
meaning: Evidence exists but the existing system marks it stale

deterministic_trigger: Existing status explicitly says missing absent or not found
meaning: Expected evidence is absent in the existing context

deterministic_trigger: Existing status explicitly says gated not admitted or blocked use
meaning: Evidence is intentionally unavailable for this use

deterministic_trigger: Existing status explicitly says unavailable not_available or cannot supply
meaning: Existing system cannot currently supply the evidence

deterministic_trigger: Existing identity status explicitly says review unresolved partial ambiguous exception or blocked
meaning: Identity authority is caveated and no fallback is attempted

deterministic_trigger: Existing source or caveat text explicitly says caveat conflict restricted review-only review only or warning
meaning: Source use has an existing restriction or caveat

deterministic_trigger: Blank unknown or unrecognized existing state
meaning: The adapter lacks enough explicit status to classify safely
not_equivalent_to: Valid current missing gated stale or unavailable
